subject: Security discovery: log retention, backups, deletion SLA — next steps
messages:
From: Claire Hughes <claire@medivue.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Medivue Security Team <security@medivue.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 10:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Demo and security follow-up

Hi Naomi —

Thanks again for the demo today. The team at Medivue is interested in moving forward with a pilot, but our security/compliance group pulled a few follow-ups I need to capture so they can sign off. Quick items they asked to confirm: 

- SOC 2: Are you SOC 2 Type II certified today or in process? If in process, what is the expected timeline?
- Data residency & GDPR: For EU patient data, do you support regional isolation / data residency?
- HIPAA: How do you treat PHI in hosted mode? Are BAAs available?
- Deletion SLA: If we request data deletion for a customer dataset, what is the guaranteed time-to-delete including backups?
- Logs / backups: What is your default retention for request logs, KV caches, and backup snapshots? Any SLA to shorten them?

I've attached our standard vendor security questionnaire — could you or your security team start that? We can return the completed PDF.

Next steps from our side: our Security Ops will review your answers and confirm whether we can proceed to a short pilot (2–4 weeks) with obfuscated test data.

Appreciate a concise bulleted response we can use internally.

Best,
Claire Hughes
Director, Cloud Ops
Medivue Health

Attachments: Medivue_Security_Questionnaire_v1.pdf (application/pdf, 1.2MB)
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Hughes <claire@medivue.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 16:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Demo and security follow-up

Hi Claire — thanks for the clear list and for sending the questionnaire. Looping in Ben (solutions) and Markus (security) to handle the technical answers and the questionnaire fill. Quick summary up front so you can paste into your internal ticket: 

- SOC 2: Redwood is currently undergoing SOC 2 Type II audit; fieldwork is complete and report expected Q1 2027 (target mid-Feb). We can provide our SOC 2 Type I evidence and interim controls documentation today.
- GDPR / Data residency: Hosted API supports region routing; EU data residency available in the EU region. For pilot, we can route all traffic through our EU cluster if required.
- HIPAA / PHI: We support HIPAA workloads under Redwood Private or Dedicated; BAAs are available for enterprise contracts. For hosted pilots we can discuss narrow-scope BAA terms.
- Deletion SLA (candidate): Standard deletion request for primary data is 30 days. For backups/snapshots, we currently keep 90 days by default but can offer shorter log retention or expedited scrub options in Dedicated/Private plans; we’ll confirm contractual SLAs per tier.
- Logs: Request logs and tracing default retention is 90 days (configurable). KV caching is ephemeral per instance but persists differently for Dedicated—will clarify exact backups behavior in the attached doc.

Next steps we propose: 
1) Markus will start filling your vendor questionnaire and flag any items that need legal or infra inputs.
2) Ben will prepare a short one‑page summary (controls + timelines) you can hand to Security Ops.
3) We’ll supply SOC 2 interim docs and a short guide on deletion workflow (how we handle primary + backup data).

Attaching: Redwood_Security_Overview_2026.pdf (short control mapping + retention defaults).

If this looks good, Markus and Ben — will you take point on the questionnaire and the one-pager respectively? Claire, expect the completed questionnaire back within 48 hours and the one‑pager within 24 hours.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: Redwood_Security_Overview_2026.pdf (application/pdf, 240KB)
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Hughes <claire@medivue.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 08:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Demo and security follow-up

Claire / Naomi —

Thanks — I started working through the attached questionnaire and left a few notes inline where we need a bit more context from Medivue (marked with TODO). High level clarifications below so your Security Ops team gets quick answers: 

1) SOC 2 status: As Naomi noted, fieldwork complete; expected SOC 2 Type II report mid-Feb 2027. Interim evidence (control matrices, penetration test summary, and change management logs) available now — I’ve attached a redacted control export for initial review.

2) Deletion flow (how it actually works): 
   - Primary data deletion: We run a deletion job that removes customer data from primary stores and application layer within 24–72 hours depending on data size and queue.
   - Backups & snapshots: Backups are on a 7/30/90 schedule depending on class (hot snapshots kept 7 days, incremental 30 days, full backup 90 days). Full physical removal from long-term backup stores may take up to 90 days.
   - Expedited scrub: For Dedicated/Private customers we can add contractual expedited scrub (e.g., 7-day full purge) for an additional compliance addendum.

3) Logs and KV cache: 
   - Request logs/traces: default 90 days; we can configure shorter retention (30 days) for the pilot environment.
   - KV cache: typically ephemeral, but persistent checkpointing for Dedicated clusters can persist for up to 30 days; not used for storing PHI.

4) HIPAA / BAA: BAAs available for Dedicated and Private deployments. For hosted pilots we can do limited-scope BAA discussions — suggest pilot use obfuscated or synthetic data.

Action items I’ll deliver: 
- Completed questionnaire (filled PDF) — target: 2026-12-22 16:00 UTC
- Redacted control export (attached) — now
- Short deletion-playbook doc (how requests flow, owner, timelines) — 2026-12-22 EOD

If Medivue security wants a 30-minute sync to walk through the deletion/playbook and backup lifecycle, I’m available tomorrow 14:00–16:00 UTC.

Regards,
Markus Klein
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai

Attachment: redacted_control_export_2026.pdf (application/pdf, 95KB)
From: Claire Hughes <claire@medivue.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Medivue Security Team <security@medivue.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 09:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Demo and security follow-up

Thanks Naomi/Markus — this is exactly what we needed. A couple quick clarifications from our Security Ops: 

- Pilot data: we will use obfuscated patient data for the pilot. OK to route to EU for regional tests? (Yes per Naomi’s note.)
- Deletion expectation: Security Ops wants a written confirmation that primary deletion completes within 30 days for pilot data (including any replicated stores) and that backup snapshots will not be relied on as a source of truth after deletion request. Can you confirm the 30-day primary deletion SLA as a pilot commitment?
- SOC 2: interim evidence is fine for now; we’ll request the final report once available.

We’re good to schedule the 30-minute sync — Claire (me) + two from Security Ops, Wed 2026-12-22 15:00 UTC would work. Please confirm.

If you can return the completed questionnaire and one-pager to security@medivue.com, we’ll queue internal review.

Thanks — looking forward to the pilot.

—Claire
